summary: Connect distances, angles and coordinates before interpreting vectors, cameras and robot frames.
outcomes: Use sine, cosine and radians to describe planar motion
Separate an object from its coordinates in a chosen frame
sequence: Locate points on axes with units
Relate right triangles to sine and cosine
Track an angle on the unit circle
Rotate a point into a different coordinate frame

visual.question: Does rotating the axes move the physical point?
visual.interaction: Rotate the frame and compare changed coordinates with unchanged distances

practice.task: Describe one point in two rotated planar frames
practice.success: Coordinates reconstruct the same point with consistent units and rotation direction
